tagline.text: Iloilo's best-known nightlife strip in Mandurriao, packed with bars, clubs and restaurants

location.label: Location
location.text: Mandurriao District, Iloilo City, beside Diversion Road (around San Jose and San Pedro Streets)

best_season.label: Best time to visit
best_season.text: Year-round (evenings; outdoor movement is easiest in the December–May dry season)

budget.label: Budget
budget.text: About ₱500~2,000 (per person, dinner, drinks and transport)

children.text: Smallville Complex is a dense cluster of restaurants, bars, clubs and karaoke venues in Mandurriao District, Iloilo City. The name originally referred to one complex beside the Iloilo Business Hotel, but today it is used for the whole surrounding area. It suits an evening of dinner, live music and a few drinks.

Smallville Complex is a commercial and entertainment district in Mandurriao District, Iloilo City. Wikipedia explains that the name originally referred to a group of restaurants, bars and clubs next to the Iloilo Business Hotel, and that as the surroundings grew it came to mean the whole neighborhood. It was once regarded as the center of Iloilo's nightlife, and later new developments across Mandurriao spread the evening scene over several areas. Addresses differ from source to source. A local guide site places it beside Diversion Road (Senator Benigno Aquino Jr. Avenue), while another listing gives the corner of San Jose and San Pedro Streets. Searching for Smallville Complex in a map app points to the same spot.

For travelers, this is less a sightseeing attraction than a neighborhood to visit in the evening. It is fairly quiet by day, and once the sun sets the bars, music venues and restaurants open and the mood picks up. JLK Music Bar, which plays 80s music, and MO2 Ice, a dance club upstairs, come up most often, and with hotels, karaoke rooms and a convenience store nearby, you can eat, drink and sleep within one area. One travel guide recommends it as an easy place for solo travelers and says locals are friendly and happy to chat.

Keep in mind that many reviews and guides for this area are old. Venue names and opening status change often, and some once-famous bars have closed. For example, listings such as Wanderlog mark Byron's in Smallville as permanently closed, and the Calle Iloilo Street Fair, a night market in the nearby Festive Walk area that used to run Thursday to Sunday from about 5 PM to 2 AM, is also listed as closed on Wanderlog and Restaurant Guru. Before you go, check recent reviews and opening hours on Google Maps or the venue's Facebook page.

One strength of Smallville is how easily it links to other Iloilo sights. To the south, a pedestrian link leads to the Iloilo River Esplanade and the Riverside Boardwalk, and to the north a road connects to Atria Park District by Ayala. The most natural plan is to stroll the riverfront by day and carry on to dinner and a drink in Smallville in the evening.

Wikipedia describes Smallville as a commercial and entertainment district of Iloilo City and says it was once considered the center of the city's nightlife. It is still the first night-time neighborhood named in local guides and reviews. Reviews consistently say weekend evenings are far livelier than weekdays.

This music bar has a DJ spinning 80s hits, and is described as having blue lighting and a disco ball. Its address is listed near the Red Square Building on San Jose Street, with a Google rating of around 4.4. The number of reviews is small, so check on a map app whether it is currently open.

Often mentioned as the biggest dance club in Smallville, it is on the upper floor and sometimes features DJs or live bands. Reviews suggest arriving around 9:30 PM to avoid the happy-hour crowd. Its rating is only average, so it is best enjoyed for the atmosphere with modest expectations.

blocks.title: Restaurants and bars in one place

children.text: An older local guide says the area has Italian, American steakhouse, Filipino fusion and Ilonggo seafood restaurants. Because you can move from dinner to a bar within the same area, some reviews note that club hopping is easy. Individual venues can change, so check on site.

The local guide site says the karaoke rooms in the Smallville21 complex and the MO2 annex are popular. Room rates depend on time and group size, so confirm on site. With a group, it is a more relaxed choice than a club.

Hotels such as the Iloilo Business Hotel, MO2 Westown Hotel and Smallville21 Hotel are listed in and around the complex. You can stay out late and walk back to your room. Prices vary by season, so check a booking site.

The south side of Smallville connects by a pedestrian link to the Riverside Boardwalk and the Iloilo River Esplanade. A natural plan is to walk the riverfront around sunset and cross over to Smallville after dark. The boardwalk is described as having relatively quiet cafes and restaurants.

Straight Up, a rooftop bar with skyline views, is listed on the 7th floor of Seda Atria in Atria Park District. The Foodville, on the Diversion Road side, is a compound of small restaurants and bars said to be popular with young people. Opening status and promotions change often.

items.title: One-evening plan
items.subtitle: Riverfront walk, dinner and a music bar

children.text: Walk the Iloilo River Esplanade or the Riverside Boardwalk and enjoy the riverfront at sunset. A pedestrian link continues to Smallville.
Have dinner at a restaurant in Smallville. An older guide puts a mid-range meal for two at about
, but many places charge more now, so check the menu.
Settle in at a music bar such as JLK Music Bar, known for its 80s music atmosphere. Check on a map app beforehand that it is open.
If the mood is right, move on to a dance club such as MO2 Ice. Reviews suggest arriving around
to avoid the happy-hour crowd.
Walk back if your hotel is close, or take Grab if it is far. Late at night, waits for a ride-hailing car can be long.
Closing times differ by venue, and on weekdays the area can quiet down early.
Have dinner at a Smallville restaurant. Seafood and Filipino food are listed.
Book a karaoke room, for example in the Smallville21 complex or the MO2 annex. Rates depend on room size and time, so confirm the hourly rate and minimum order before you go in.
Wrap up with a rest at a nearby convenience store or cafe, then head back to your hotel.

items.title: By plane from Manila to Iloilo

children.text: There are direct flights from Manila (NAIA) to Iloilo International Airport (ILO), and the flight takes a little over an hour. Airlines and times change by season, so check before booking.
Iloilo International Airport is about
northwest of the city (in Cabatuan). From the airport to Mandurriao you can take a taxi, Grab or a van. Fares and travel times vary with traffic, so check locally.
From central Iloilo City, take a taxi or Grab. Telling the driver Smallville Complex is usually enough. It is also close to SM City Iloilo on Diversion Road.
Jeepney and taxi fares in the city change. For short rides, make sure the driver uses the meter.
You can walk from the Iloilo River Esplanade along the pedestrian link. After dark, stick to well-lit paths.

Because this is a nightlife area, you can visit in the evening at any time of year. The biggest factor is the day of the week rather than the season. Reviews consistently say weekday nights are quiet and Friday and Saturday evenings are the liveliest.

In the December–May dry season, riverfront walks and moving around outdoors are comfortable, while in the rainy season evening showers are frequent, so plan around indoor venues. During the Dinagyang Festival in late January, all of Iloilo gets crowded, so book your hotel and transport early and check the event schedule in official announcements.

Hotels in and around the complex, such as the Iloilo Business Hotel, MO2 Westown Hotel and Smallville21 Hotel, are convenient because the nightlife is within walking distance. If you are sensitive to noise, avoid rooms on the club side on weekend nights and request a room location in advance. Check a booking site for rates and ratings.

The area is described as offering Italian, American steakhouse, Filipino home cooking and Ilonggo seafood, plus coffee and dessert shops. The line-up changes often. We suggest trying Iloilo's famous La Paz batchoy elsewhere in the city, and enjoying seafood and bar snacks in Smallville.
Before you visit, check recent Google Maps reviews and the venue's Facebook page to confirm it is open. Many guides are out of date.
The liveliest time is weekend evenings. Weekdays can be quiet, so set your expectations accordingly.
Tell Grab or taxi drivers Smallville Complex.
Some reviews advise going to clubs around 9:30 PM to avoid the happy-hour crowd.
Bring both cash and a card, as small venues may not accept cards.
Some venues may ask for ID, so carry your passport copy or other identification.
If your hotel is far, check your ride back on Grab in advance. Late at night, it can be hard to get a car.
A practical plan is to see city sights such as the Esplanade, Jaro and Molo by day and come to Smallville in the evening.
Late at night many people are drunk and it can get loud and rowdy, so watch your belongings and your group, and do not overdrink.
Some old reviews mention late-night noise and worry about minors being let in. These are unverified anecdotes, so treat them only as a reference.
When you are served a drink, keep your eyes on the glass and do not accept drinks offered by strangers.
Keep your phone and wallet in a front pocket or the inner part of your bag, and do not carry large amounts of cash.
Do not follow touts to unfamiliar venues, and check prices before you receive the bill.
Opening hours, prices and venues may have changed since this article's date, so check the latest information.
